newsitem.title: USA: ICOS affiliate plans $100 mln private offer.
newsitem.headline: ICOS affiliate plans $100 mln private offer.

text.p: ICOS Corp said its ICOS Clinical Partners LP affiliate planned to offer private investors up to $100 million of interests in the partnership.
In connection with the deal, ICOS said it planned to issue warrants to buy up to 17.5 million ICOS common shares.

One-half of the warrants would be exercisable over a four-year period starting in October 1998 and the others would be issued in June 1999 and would be exercisable over a five-year period starting July 1999, it said.
ICOS said the offering was to provide funding for continued development, clinical testing and commercialisation of certain therapeutic products.
